pages.title: VELLARIO · COMO
pages.lead: An idea born from the elegance of Lake Como, expressed through a new collection of Italian nautical design studies.

sections.title: A lake. A point of view.
sections.body: Como is more than a location. Its landscape, architecture and relationship with the water form the cultural reference for VELLARIO.

sections.title: The Italian Dolce Vita
sections.body: The pleasure of time spent well: unhurried journeys, beautiful places and the simple privilege of being on the water.

sections.title: Five distinct directions
sections.body: The collection begins with Quantum 999, MAS 36, MAS 56, GranTender 72 and Gran Marlin. Each is presented as a design study, not an already manufactured VELLARIO yacht.

sections.title: History & Legacy
sections.body: The Larian boating tradition provides a cultural starting point, not an invented company history. Its stories belong to generations of craftspeople, designers and boatbuilders.

sections.title: Design & Craftsmanship
sections.body: A contemporary interpretation of proportion, detailing and personal expression, to be developed with rigorous design and carefully selected future production partners.

sections.title: The Maison
sections.body: VELLARIO is conceived as an independent, design-led luxury nautical brand: distinctive identity, meticulous direction and an individual relationship with each future client.

sections.title: A conversation begins
sections.body: The commercial introduction and dedicated contact channel will be published after verification. Explore the collection and the story in the meantime.

pages.title: Como
pages.lead: The landscape behind the vision. Water, stone, light and a culture shaped by the lake.

sections.title: The Lake
sections.body: The Lario is not a decorative background to the brand. Its relationship between mountains, shorelines and water is the geographic starting point for VELLARIO.

sections.title: Villas & Architecture
sections.body: The lake's villas are part of an enduring architectural culture. Villa del Balbianello, on the promontory of Lavedo in Lenno, is a documented example of its layered history.

sections.title: Living With Water
sections.body: At Como, moving across the water changes the perspective of place. The shore is experienced through approach, distance, arrival and return. This is a creative direction, not a historical claim.

sections.title: Nautical Culture
sections.body: The Museo Barca Lariana at Pianello del Lario preserves historic boats, motors and nautical records, providing a documented foundation for understanding the lake's boating culture.

sections.title: The Inspiration
sections.body: VELLARIO draws creative inspiration from this context. The intention is to develop a contemporary nautical identity connected to the Lario without claiming the achievements of historical boatyards as its own.

pages.title: Italian Dolce Vita
pages.lead: Not the pursuit of more. The art of making a moment memorable.

sections.title: The Luxury of Time
sections.body: A quiet morning, a long arrival, a table shared without hurry. Our proposed lifestyle language values time and experience before spectacle.

sections.title: On the Water
sections.body: The water is a destination and a perspective. The nautical object matters because of the life it makes possible—not as a backdrop to a generic luxury campaign.

sections.title: Italian Elegance
sections.body: Restraint, proportion, hospitality and attention to detail form the intended VELLARIO sensibility. The definitive lifestyle photography and styling are still to be produced.

sections.title: Life Aboard
sections.body: The on-board narrative will follow verified yacht layouts and photography. No cabin, furniture, amenity or finished interior is attributed to a model until its source is approved.

sections.title: Explore the Collection
sections.body: The five design studies are the product expression of this vision.

pages.title: The Collection
pages.lead: Five different expressions of nautical design, gathered into one developing VELLARIO collection.

sections.title: Discover the Five
sections.body: Quantum 999 · MAS 36 · MAS 56 · GranTender 72 · Gran Marlin. Select a design study to explore its original visual material.

sections.title: Original Design Archive
sections.body: The imagery in these pages is drawn from the existing project archive. It is not evidence of manufacture, deliveries, specifications or a verified VELLARIO production partner.

sections.title: Personalisation · Vision
sections.body: The commercial ambition is one-to-one design direction and carefully considered individual expression. An operating customisation service has not yet been announced.

sections.title: Private Enquiries
sections.body: A verified direct contact channel is still being prepared. This preview does not collect enquiries or personal data.

pages.title: History & Legacy
pages.lead: The history belongs to the lake. Our task is to understand it before proposing a new chapter.

sections.title: A Culture of Water
sections.body: Boats on Lake Como have served work, transport, sport and leisure. The Museo Barca Lariana documents these traditions through historic vessels and objects.

sections.title: From Workboats to Runabouts
sections.body: The museum's collections include rowing and working boats, sailing craft, leisure motorboats and racing hulls—a history wider than the familiar polished runabout.

sections.title: Craft & Competition
sections.body: Historic makers and performance craft form part of the Larian tradition. Source material must distinguish the work of established builders from the future VELLARIO brand.

sections.title: Preserving the Memory
sections.body: The museum at Pianello del Lario occupies a former nineteenth-century silk mill and preserves the material culture of boating on the lake. No relationship with VELLARIO is claimed.

sections.title: A Contemporary Interpretation
sections.body: VELLARIO proposes a design-led interpretation of these cultural references. This is inspiration, not a claim of inherited shipyard history. Riva was founded at Sarnico on Lake Iseo, not on Lake Como.

pages.title: Design & Craftsmanship
pages.lead: A boat should have a recognisable identity before it carries a signature.

sections.title: Proportion First
sections.body: Length, line, surface and balance are the first questions of nautical design. The portfolio presents visual studies; a unified VELLARIO design language remains to be formalised.

sections.title: Exterior Design
sections.body: The original archive contains model-specific renders and project imagery. The final exterior design narrative will be built around approved sources, not around generic claims of performance.

sections.title: Materials & Details
sections.body: The intended material language favours considered finish, durable elegance and tactile precision. Specific suppliers, finishes and certified materials are not yet confirmed.

sections.title: Engineering Discipline
sections.body: Performance, dimensions, propulsion and compliance will be documented only when project documentation and construction plans have been authorised and verified.

sections.title: Personalisation
sections.body: Individual colour, finish and layout direction is part of the proposed luxury brand architecture. Formal offerings and production capability remain future decisions.

pages.title: The Maison
pages.lead: A new Italian nautical maison conceived to bring extraordinary attention to the relationship between design, water and the individual.

sections.title: The Beginning
sections.body: VELLARIO begins with an entrepreneurial ambition: to make a nautical object as singular and desirable as the finest collector's objects, with a distinctly Italian sensibility.

sections.title: Italian Identity
sections.body: The cultural reference is Lake Como—its landscape, architectural restraint and boating tradition—interpreted with a contemporary design perspective.

sections.title: A Design-Led Maison
sections.body: The intended business is asset-light: the brand will direct design, product specification, quality standards and client experience, while production is envisaged through future selected external shipyards. No yard agreement is claimed.

sections.title: The Relationship
sections.body: The intended client experience is direct, discreet and individual. A confirmed commercial process, showroom and post-sale service network have not yet been announced.

sections.title: What Comes Next
sections.body: Brand foundations, verified media, project strategy and a coherent collection come before production and launch. The next chapter will be communicated only when supported by real milestones.

pages.title: Contact
pages.lead: A direct relationship deserves a real point of contact.

sections.title: A Personal Introduction
sections.body: VELLARIO is being developed as a selective, design-led nautical maison. The dedicated client communications channel is not yet active.

sections.title: Contact Details
sections.body: A verified public email address, enquiry workflow and response process will appear here once approved. No form is displayed because it would not yet have a genuine recipient.

sections.title: Privacy & Enquiries
sections.body: Before personal information is collected, the appropriate privacy information and a verified receiving system will be implemented. This preview collects no personal details.

quantum-999.tagline: A contemporary study of nautical form.
quantum-999.lead: Quantum 999 is an original design-archive project selected for the developing VELLARIO collection.
quantum-999.concept: The original Quantum 999 visual archive is the only source used on this page. A final design manifesto and technical brief have not been approved.
quantum-999.exterior: The renderings introduce the project's exterior study. No dimension, material or performance claim is inferred from the images.
quantum-999.aboard: The approved arrangement and on-board experience are still being reviewed. We will publish layout material only when it matches the project documentation.
quantum-999.details: Finish studies and detailing will be sourced from original project files before they are described in the VELLARIO language.

mas-36.tagline: An original study, shown through its renderings.
mas-36.lead: MAS 36 is presented with original images from its design portfolio. A historical press kit and TIFF master files are available for editorial review.
mas-36.concept: The design reference is an existing MAS 36 project, not a VELLARIO vessel already built. Product positioning is still being defined.
mas-36.exterior: Sharp original renderings take priority over footage that does not meet the visual standard. The model's silhouette will be curated from the verified archive.
mas-36.aboard: Original layouts and visual material must be reviewed before descriptions of interiors or deck arrangements are published.
mas-36.details: Material finishes shown in the archive cannot be treated as confirmed VELLARIO build specifications.

mas-56.lead: MAS 56 is the confirmed name of the third VELLARIO collection study, with its own rendering and film archive.
mas-56.concept: The MAS 56 imagery is assigned exclusively to this model. MAS 52 is no longer the name of this collection entry.
mas-56.exterior: The model's widescreen renderings and moving-image material are a basis for future editorial work, not a declaration of production readiness.
mas-56.aboard: The on-board arrangement and amenity descriptions will be developed from approved project plans, not invented from imagery.
mas-56.details: Detailed materials, build standards and personalisation options remain to be technically validated.

grantender-72.tagline: A tender study in the original design archive.
grantender-72.lead: GranTender 72 is a distinct project with renderings, source design models and presentation materials in the archive.
grantender-72.concept: GranTender is the collection name. The original MAXITENDER-named assets are archival sources, not a second boat in the range.
grantender-72.exterior: The existing materials allow a visual presentation of the original design study, while any final VELLARIO design specification awaits approval.
grantender-72.aboard: Deck layouts and arrangements require review of the available project drawings before publication.
grantender-72.details: The existence of CAD and render source files does not demonstrate that a VELLARIO-built GranTender exists.

gran-marlin.tagline: An original design archive, thoughtfully presented.
gran-marlin.lead: Gran Marlin brings a distinct source project into the VELLARIO collection study, supported by original imagery and bilingual press material.
gran-marlin.concept: Historic sources use the designation Gran Marlin 46. The working VELLARIO label is Gran Marlin; legacy technical data are not automatically transferred.
gran-marlin.exterior: Only the project's own renderings and film are used. Exterior characteristics will be described after the original documentation has been reviewed.
gran-marlin.aboard: On-board descriptions, accommodation and dimensions remain to be verified against the real project files.
gran-marlin.details: The available press imagery is a candidate for editorial selection, subject to attribution and usage-rights review.
